previous_statement: For nonvanishing P and e<=e_ca, lem-compcb-corner-algebra says that S_P, with the compressed product dot and inherited involution, is an extended C_ca*e-C*-algebra. By the registered definition of extended epsilon-C*-algebra, for each n the amplified algebra M_n tensor S_P obeys the lower C*-axiom for its amplified compressed product: ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2 for every Z in M_n tensor S_P. Taking K_sq>=C_ca gives exactly the square antecedent required by node 1.2 at every n, not merely at n=1.
new_statement: Corrected dependency audit: for nonvanishing P and e<=e_ca, lem-compcb-corner-algebra concludes only, in the exact permitted language, that S_P with its compressed product and inherited involution is an extended (C_ca*e)-C*-algebra. The registered workspace definitions contain no definition of extended epsilon-C*-algebra and hence no allowed implication from that label to the assertion that every M_n tensor S_P is a (C_ca*e)-C*-algebra for the entrywise-amplified compressed product. The registered epsilon-banach-cstar-norm-axioms provides the lower C*-axiom only once such an amplified epsilon-C*-algebra premise has been established, and operator-space-matrix-norm-axioms supplies only matrix-norm and involution axioms. Therefore the all-n estimate ||Z^dagger dot Z|| >= (1-C_ca*e)||Z||^2, and thus node 1.2's square antecedent at dyadic levels, do not follow from the exact allowed inputs. This node withdraws the former bridge; it can be restored only by provisioning the missing byte-matched extended-algebra definition (or an upstream contract that explicitly states the amplified square inequality).
